record.dic_text:
07028 Qiyshown {kee-shone'}

源自 06983; 專有名詞  地名

AV - Kishon 6; 6

基順 = "蜿蜒"
1) 巴勒斯坦中部的一條河; 士師時代耶賓的將軍西西拉於此為以色列所敗
   (#士 4:7,13|); 以利亞時追擊巴力的先知, 而擊殺於此河邊之地 (#王上 18:40|)
record.edic_text:
07028 Qiyshown {kee-shone'}

from 06983;; n pr loc

AV - Kishon 6; 6

Kishon = "winding"
1) a river in central Palestine; scene of the defeat of Sisera by the
   Israelites in the time of the judges and the destruction of the
   prophets of Baal by Elijah
